purpose: Non-scoring provenance registry for frontend-design practitioner skills, standards, validated UX instruments, and reference workflows. This registry is quarantined from the frozen GitHub benchmark and does not modify Neta behavior.

sources.name: Anthropic frontend-design skill
sources.notes: Official Anthropic repository. Treat as practitioner design guidance, not empirical proof.

sources.name: Impeccable
cannot_establish: independent corroboration of inherited Anthropic claims
sources.notes: README explicitly states that Impeccable started from Anthropic frontend-design. Novel extensions may be treated separately from inherited rules at claim level.

sources.name: Emil Kowalski design engineering skills
sources.notes: Strong craft source for interaction details. Exact durations, easing choices, and component recipes remain practitioner heuristics unless separately validated.

sources.name: Leon Lin taste-skill
sources.notes: The skill itself says its rules are contextual. Its numeric default dials are implementation heuristics, not validated scales.

sources.name: design-taste synthesis
sources.license: MIT core with mixed upstream licenses in references
cannot_establish: additional independent corroboration for inherited claims
sources.notes: NOTICE declares synthesis from Emil Kowalski, Impeccable, and taste-skill. Never count a repeated inherited rule as a new independent source.

sources.name: Superdesign skill
cannot_establish: that baseline reproduction improves user outcomes
sources.notes: Best treated as a reference implementation of a design-agent workflow rather than evidence that the workflow is optimal.

sources.name: frontend-design-skills curated corpus
sources.notes: README reports 809 pages from 12 sources synthesized into 19 domains and 21 skills. Use as an index to candidate claims, then trace claims to primary sources.

sources.name: WCAG 2.2
sources.version: W3C Recommendation; 2024-12-12 update; ISO/IEC 40500:2025 equivalent to October 2023 WCAG 2.2
sources.license: W3C document terms; reference only in this registry
cannot_establish: field comprehension outside tested success criteria
sources.notes: Normative authority for accessibility scope only. Conformance must not be laundered into a generic UX-quality verdict.

sources.name: ISO 9241-110:2020
sources.version: Edition 2, 2020; reviewed and confirmed current in 2025
sources.license: ISO copyrighted standard; metadata and bounded paraphrase only
cannot_establish: that a principle is violated in a specific product without local evidence
sources.notes: Useful external mechanism/interaction boundary. It does not choose the product-specific intervention.

sources.name: User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ)
sources.license: Materials distributed free of charge by UEQ authors; reference instrument rather than copied content
useful_for: pre/post or comparative evaluation when protocol is appropriate
sources.notes: A measurement instrument belongs to FIELD evidence. It should not become a frontend rule.

sources.name: UMUX-LITE
sources.license: ACM publication; citation and bounded paraphrase only
useful_for: brief field measurement of perceived ease of use and usefulness
cannot_establish: field behavior beyond the measured constructs
sources.notes: The original paper reports adequate psychometric quality and high concurrent validity with SUS. Use as measurement, not design authority.
